Industrial Data Pipeline at TUM AIS

Visual workflows for industrial time-series processing

I work as a student assistant at TUM's Institute of Automation and Information Systems in Munich.

I am developing a desktop application for visually building and running industrial time-series processing workflows. The application uses Python, PySide6, NumPy, SciPy, and HDF5.

The pipeline covers CSV-to-HDF5 ingestion, signal transformation, resampling, segmentation, change-point detection, and result visualization. The aim is to make each processing step visible and configurable in one desktop workflow.
